android.desc:
Do you remember when you learned to brush? Neither do we! It turns out, most people don’t brush properly.

If you’ve ever wondered how well you’re brushing or if you’re reaching every spot, the Philips Sonicare app is here to help. The app brings more clarity, more confidence and more personal insights into your routine.

When you connect your Sonicare toothbrush, you’ll unlock personalized coaching designed to help you strengthen your habits and brighten your smile.

Please note you must have a connected toothbrush to use the app. By connecting to the app, you’ll also receive the latest updates to your brushing experience.

Our most advanced toothbrush – the Next-Generation Sonicare DiamondClean 9900 Prestige – harmonizes with the app, creating an experience that’s smart and supportive, including:

- Real-time guided brushing that helps you feel confident every session 
- SenseIQ technology that senses and adapts to you 
- Auto-sync so your brushing data stays updated, even when your phone’s not around

Your Sonicare app experience will vary depending on which toothbrush you own and where you live: 

PREMIUM
- Next-Generation DiamondClean 9900 Prestige, Next-Generation DiamondClean 9500, Next-Generation DiamondClean 9000, Next-Generation DiamondClean 8700, Next-Generation DiamondClean 8500, Next-Generation DiamondClean 8000 and DiamondClean Prestige 9900 — SenseIQ, mouth map, personalized guidance and tips. 

ADVANCED 
- DiamondClean Smart and FlexCare Platinum Connected – mouth map with position guidance and missed area notifications. 

ESSENTIAL 
- Sonicare 6500, Sonicare 7100, DiamondClean 9000 and ExpertClean - SmarTimer and brushing guides.

In the Sonicare app: 

Brushing check-in 
You will receive an assessment of your technique after the first time you brush your teeth. This will provide a starting point to track improvements to your oral health routine over time. 

Real-time brushing guidance 
The Sonicare app checks your habits, like if you’re reaching all areas of your mouth, how long you brush or how much pressure you’re using, and coaches you with tailored advice. This coaching helps to ensure consistent, complete coverage, every time you brush. 

Dental Diary 
The Dental Diary helps you track all your oral health habits in one place – brushing, flossing, tongue cleaning, and mouth rinsing – so you can spot trends and build a consistent routine.
